messages.en:
{07 00 00}That letter's for 
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 14 00}As long as you deliver it 
by the time you promised,{01 00 00 05 00}
I won't squawk at you.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See kiri on
tüübile nimega {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 14 00}Kuni sa toimetad selle
kohale lubatud ajaks,{01 00 00 05 00}
ma sinu peale ei kräunu.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}! I don't
wanna rush you or
anything, but...
{07 14 00}If you don't get my letter
to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} on time,{01 00 00 0a 00}
I'll pout at you.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}! Ma ei taha
sind tagant kiirustada
ega midagi, aga...
{07 14 00}Kui sa ei vii mu kirja
õigeks ajaks {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} kätte,{01 00 00 0a 00}
siis ma tõmban mossi.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} you still
have that letter for
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, {07 0b 00}don't you?
{07 00 00}Deliver it by the time
we agreed, OK, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?{01 01 00}
Or you'll regret it!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} sul on ikka
see kiri
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} jaoks, {07 0b 00}kas pole?
{07 00 00}Vii see kokkulepitud ajaks
kohale, eks, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?{01 01 00}
Või sa kahetsed!
